acceptance: Zero active consumers of retired objects (workflows, labels, scripts, targets); legitimate historical references are listed
Property ledger complete: high-risk rows proven, others waived with reasons (dlv2-evidence-reconcile); retained-workflow inventory has owner and purpose

Current snapshot recorded: T1/T2 p95, merges/day, public target count, retry rate, red-trunk incidents (a failing trunk.yml run on develop until fixed/reverted); runner wait is dropped (owner decision 2026-10-27)
The 30-day comparison is a separate item (dlv2-30day-metrics) and does not gate this closeout
description:
AUDIT 2026-10-27 (owner-adjudicated, advisor-reviewed): the acceptance and context sections supersede this description wherever they differ. Historical text below is kept for reference.

DECISION GATE closing the program. Run one repository-wide sweep for every deleted workflow, job, script, Make target, label, secret, branch, and config name. Build the list from the PRs that actually deleted them: #2450 (pr.yml), #2582, #2650, #2671, the site-split PRs, and the PRs for dlv2-42, dlv2-53, dlv2-70, dlv2-80, dlv2-81, dlv2-82 and dlv2-83. List each PR's removed files with `gh api repos/BenchBox-dev/benchbox/pulls/<n>/files --paginate --jq '.[] | select(.status=="removed" or .status=="renamed") | .filename'`. Do not build the list from dlv2-40..83: dlv2-40 and dlv2-41 were dropped. Confirm the property ledger has no uncovered property; commit the workflow inventory table.

Retained workflows, by name: ci, trunk, nightly (nightly-v2 renamed), release, oracle-review, oracle-verdict, soundness-merge-digest, site-inputs, gitignore-lint, validate-submission, validate-submission-comment, sync-results-data-to-published, corpus-event-bridge, corpus-reconciler, seed-corpus, upload-answers, todo-state-validate, tpcds-official-qualification, tpcds-platform-identity and tpch-dbgen-intel-macos. Confirm this list against .github/workflows at audit time; any other file there needs a recorded owner and purpose or must be deleted.

Metrics, compared 30 days after the last cleanup merges against the 2026-09-28 baseline (_project/archive/dev-loop-v2/baseline.md): T1 p95 <=7 min incl. setup; T2 p95 <=15 min; develop-red incidents 0; Make targets <=90; flake retry rate <2%.

How to measure. _project/scripts/dev_loop_pr_metrics.py (the baseline tool) is on dlv2-42's delete list. Run it from the baseline commit instead: `git worktree add <dir> 64f2f1f603083fc3f6b9c3b13d12ce73f97e6fd3` and run the script there against the current repository (or commit a replacement that reads the same `gh` data and name it in the snapshot). Record which was used.
Target count method: `make -pRrq : | awk -v RS= -F: '/^# Files/,/^# Finished Make data base/ {if ($1 !~ "^[#.]") {print $1}}' | sort -u | grep -E -v -e '^[^[:alnum:]]' -e '^\$@$' | wc -l`, run at the baseline commit and at the final commit (the baseline note recorded 216 from the generated inventory; origin/develop gave 241 by this method on 2026-10-09).
